scope: experimental raw-native Gemma global checkpoint basis; MiMo excluded

implementation_goal: bounded tiles and strict paired source authority; no held entire V history

native complete codec streaming export/import and continuation
tile/data lifetime and reservations cleaned on all failures
native-vs-basis encrypted read bytes and restore time measured
horizon_followup: separate preregistration and maxSequenceLength/MTP trace before production changes
